text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through the Mainichi Hai, Yaeno Muteki 
felt it. Oguri Cap's running was serene 
and composed, in stark contrast to her 
own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she suffered defeat, she said she 
was far more satisfied with her run than 
in her debut. Next up is the first leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However—her generational rival, Mejiro 
Ardan, was forced to skip the Satsuki Sho. 
It seems the condition of her legs isn't 
looking good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, what must be done remained 
unchanged. Yaeno Muteki declared war on 
Sakura Chiyono O, vowing to win the 
Satsuki Sho.
